cyberwrite-mcp: missing required environment variable(s): CYBERWRITE_API_KEY, CYBERWRITE_INSURER_ID, CYBERWRITE_BASE_URL, CYBERWRITE_USER_EMAIL, CYBERWRITE_USER_ROLE

Set them before launching the server, for example:
  CYBERWRITE_API_KEY     your insurer API key
  CYBERWRITE_INSURER_ID  your insurer ID
  CYBERWRITE_BASE_URL    full backend URL, e.g. https://api-prod.cyberwrite.com
  CYBERWRITE_USER_EMAIL  the acting user's email
  CYBERWRITE_USER_ROLE   the acting user's role
